e.title: **把「不要编造引用」变成一条会失败的测试**：美国医疗账单申诉引擎 **PolicyCrab**——**每封草拟信在到达用户前都过一个无 LLM 的质控节点**；**它有一份 38 条法规的允许清单**，**每条都带来源 URL 与「谁在代码里断言了它」**，**并由五条守卫测试把它接到静态清单、运行时枚举与 RAG 语料三处**；**⚠️ 但本次实测到**：那份清单的默认核实日期是硬编码的，**而模块文档字符串却说「每条都应该是未核实状态」**
e.title_en: Turning never fabricate citations into a failing test: PolicyCrab, a US healthcare bill appeals engine, passes every drafted letter through a no-LLM quality node before a user sees it, keeps a 38-entry statute allowlist where each entry carries a source URL and a note on which code asserts it, and wires that allowlist to a static list, a runtime enum and the retrieval corpus through five guard tests, while a measured default verification date in that module contradicts the same module docstring claim that every entry should still be unverified.
e.title_hk: **把「不要編造引用」變成一條會失敗的測試**：美國醫療帳單申訴引擎 **PolicyCrab**——**每封草擬信在到達使用者前都過一個無 LLM 的質控節點**；**它有一份 38 條法規的允許清單**，**每條都帶來源 URL 與「誰在程式碼裡斷言了它」**，**並由五條守衛測試把它接到靜態清單、執行時列舉與 RAG 語料三處**；**⚠️ 但本次實測到**：那份清單的預設核實日期是硬編碼的，**而模組文件字串卻說「每條都應該是未核實狀態」**
e.summary: **PolicyCrab**（仓库 `sharma-sugurthi/policycrab`）**是一套面向美国医疗账单的 AI 申诉引擎**：**摄入** SBC／EOB、**确定性**判定**超收与违规、**再由自主代理起草**法规申诉信**；**语言 Python 为主**、**许可 Apache-2.0**（**本次实测 `LICENSE` 正文前五行为** Apache License Version 2.0**）**、**实测 ★1**、**11,901 KB**、**创建 2026-07-05**、**推送 2026-09-10**、**默认分支 `main`**、**README 实测 7,916 字节**、**仓库实测 478 条路径（448 文件＋30 目录）**。**它在本轮主题里的价值是「接线」的**第三种样子**：**把一句自然语言要求接到一条会失败的测试上**。**⭐⭐⭐ ①** **Accuracy Core**——**逐字**「**Every drafted letter passes through a no-LLM QA node before it reaches the user**」；**⭐⭐⭐ ②** **允许清单本身就是一份「我不知道」声明**：**逐字**「**The LLM that drafts appeal letters is told "never fabricate citations", but an instruction is not a guarantee.**」**、**「**None means NOT YET HUMAN-VERIFIED.**」**、**「**The build environment this module was authored in could not reach ecfr.gov or uscode.house.gov, so every entry ships with verified_on=None.**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ③** **⚠️ 但本次实测到一处不一致**：**同为该文件的 `AllowedCitation` 数据类把** `verified_on` **默认写成具体日期** `"2026-09-10"`、`needs_human_verification` **默认 `False`**，**而 38 条目测没有一条显式传这两个字段**——**故按所读代码推断** `allowlist_needs_human_verification()` **会返回 False**，**`DEPLOYMENT.md` 承诺的** `ALLOWLIST_NEEDS_HUMAN_VERIFICATION` **标志当下不可达**；**⭐⭐⭐ ④** **守卫测试接在三处**（**18 条逐字法规的静态清单**、**`AppealFramework` 枚举的运行时文本**、**`knowledge_base/` 全部 markdown**），**逐字理由**「**code cannot instruct the LLM to cite something we cannot verify.**」；**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤** **名单每条都带** `origin`——**「**代码里哪一处断言了它**」**（**即**这张表同时是「允许引用什么」与「谁在引用它」）；**⭐⭐ ⑥** **无 LLM 回归套件的文件头自己写明「它不断言什么」**（**逐字**「**It does NOT assert anything the LLM decides (contradiction analysis, letter text).**」）；**⭐⭐ ⑦** **CI 用四个假凭据把整套测试跑起来**（`SUPABASE_URL: "https://mock.supabase.co"`、三个 `mock_key`），**部署经无长期密钥的 Workload Identity Federation**。**⚠️ 本次未运行任何一步、未读任何 Python 业务源码**，**故不主张**任何计算、路由或法律结论正确；**⚠️ 本次另实测到两处文档与仓库不一致**（`scripts/build_citation_allowlist.py` 在仓库根 404、README 说的根目录 `.env.example` 未出现在清单里）。
e.summary_hk: **PolicyCrab**（倉庫 `sharma-sugurthi/policycrab`）**是一套面向美國醫療帳單的 AI 申訴引擎**：**攝入** SBC／EOB、**確定性**判定**超收與違規、**再由自主代理起草**法規申訴信**；**語言以 Python 為主**、**許可 Apache-2.0**（**本次實測 `LICENSE` 正文前五行**）、**實測 ★1**、**11,901 KB**、**建立 2026-07-05**、**推送 2026-09-10**、**預設分支 `main`**、**README 實測 7,916 位元組**、**倉庫實測 478 條路徑（448 檔案＋30 目錄）**。**它在本輪主題裡的價值是「接線」的**第三種樣子**：**把一句自然語言要求接到一條會失敗的測試上**。**⭐⭐⭐ ①** **Accuracy Core**——**逐字**「**Every drafted letter passes through a no-LLM QA node before it reaches the user**」；**⭐⭐⭐ ②** **允許清單本身就是一份「我不知道」聲明**：**逐字**「**The LLM that drafts appeal letters is told "never fabricate citations", but an instruction is not a guarantee.**」**、**「**None means NOT YET HUMAN-VERIFIED.**」**、**「**The build environment this module was authored in could not reach ecfr.gov or uscode.house.gov, so every entry ships with verified_on=None.**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ③** **⚠️ 但本次實測到一處不一致**：**同為該檔案的 `AllowedCitation` 資料類別把** `verified_on` **預設寫成具體日期** `"2026-09-10"`、`needs_human_verification` **預設 `False`**，**而 38 條目測沒有一條顯式傳這兩個欄位**——**故按所讀程式碼推斷** `allowlist_needs_human_verification()` **會回傳 False**，**`DEPLOYMENT.md` 承諾的** `ALLOWLIST_NEEDS_HUMAN_VERIFICATION` **標誌當下不可達**；**⭐⭐⭐ ④** **守衛測試接在三處**（**18 條逐字法規的靜態清單**、**`AppealFramework` 列舉的執行時文字**、**`knowledge_base/` 全部 markdown**），**逐字理由**「**code cannot instruct the LLM to cite something we cannot verify.**」；**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤** **名單每條都帶** `origin`——**「**程式碼裡哪一處斷言了它**」**；**⭐⭐ ⑥** **無 LLM 回歸套件的檔案頭自己寫明「它不斷言什麼」**；**⭐⭐ ⑦** **CI 用四個假憑證把整套測試跑起來**，**部署經無長期金鑰的 Workload Identity Federation**。**⚠️ 本次未運行任何一步、未讀任何 Python 業務原始碼**，**故不主張**任何計算、路由或法律結論正確；**⚠️ 本次另實測到兩處文件與倉庫不一致**。
e.summary_en: **PolicyCrab** (repository `sharma-sugurthi/policycrab`) **is an AI appeals engine for US healthcare bills**: it ingests SBC and EOB documents, adjudicates overbilling and regulatory violations deterministically, then has autonomous agents draft regulatory appeal letters; **primarily Python**, **licence Apache-2.0** with the first five lines of the `LICENSE` verified this round, **measured 1 star**, **11,901 KB**, **created 2026-07-05**, **pushed 2026-09-10**, **default branch `main`**, **README measuring 7,916 bytes**, and **478 measured repository paths, being 448 files and 30 directories**. **Its value for this round is a third shape of wiring: attaching a plain-language requirement to a test that can fail.** **First, top**: the Accuracy Core, verbatim, that every drafted letter passes through a no-LLM QA node before it reaches the user. **Second, top**: **the allowlist is itself a declaration of what is not known**, verbatim, that the LLM drafting appeal letters is told never to fabricate citations but that an instruction is not a guarantee, that a missing date means not yet human-verified, and that the build environment the module was authored in could not reach ecfr.gov or uscode.house.gov, so every entry ships unverified. **Third, top, and measured this round as an inconsistency**: the dataclass in that same file defaults the verification date to a concrete date and the human-verification flag to false, while none of the 38 entries passes either field explicitly, so on the code as read the pending-review flag the deployment guide promises is currently unreachable. **Fourth, top**: the guard tests attach the allowlist in three places, a static list of 18 verbatim statutes, the runtime text of every `AppealFramework` member, and every markdown file under the knowledge base, on the verbatim reasoning that code cannot instruct the LLM to cite something we cannot verify. **Fifth, top**: every entry carries an origin field saying where in the codebase it is asserted, so the table records both what may be cited and who cites it. **Sixth**: the file header of the LLM-free regression suite states what it does not assert. **Seventh**: CI runs the whole suite against four mock credentials, and deployment uses workload identity federation rather than a long-lived key. **Nothing was run this round and no Python business logic was read, so no computation, routing or legal conclusion is claimed to be correct; two further measured mismatches between documentation and repository are recorded.**
e.body:
**PolicyCrab**（仓库 `sharma-sugurthi/policycrab`）**是一套面向美国医疗账单的 AI 申诉引擎**：**逐字自述为**「**an AI platform built with production practices designed to help medical advocates, HR benefits managers, and individual Americans navigate the complexities of US healthcare insurance**」——**摄入** SBC／EOB 文档、**确定性**判定**超收或违规、**再由自主代理起草**法规申诉信**。**实测**：**语言以 Python 为主**、**许可 Apache-2.0**（**本次实测 `LICENSE` 正文前五行为** Apache License Version 2.0**）**、**★1**、**仓库体量 11,901 KB**、**创建 2026-07-05**、**最后推送 2026-09-10**、**默认分支 `main`**；**README 实测 7,916 字节**。**仓库经 `codeload.github.com` 的 tarball 枚举**（**本轮 GitHub 核心 API 配额已用尽**），**实测 478 条路径，其中 448 个文件、30 个目录**：`backend/` 394 条、`frontend/` 55 条、`supabase/` 11 条、`knowledge_base/` 8 条、`.github/` 3 条，**根目录另有** `README.md`、`LICENSE`、`DEPLOYMENT.md`、`SECURITY.md`、`.gitignore`。**其中可数的几组**：`backend/tests/` 下 **35 个 `test_*.py`**、`backend/app/agents/` **13 个模块**、`backend/app/engine/` **11 个模块**、`backend/app/security/` **8 个模块**、`backend/scripts/` **8 个脚本**、`supabase/migrations/` **9 个 SQL（001 到 009，按编号顺序）**、`knowledge_base/` **7 个 markdown（01 到 07）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「接线：把它接到另一套东西上能用为止」**；**本词条认为它是本轮四条里「接线」写得最严的一条**——**它把一句自然语言要求（不要编造引用）接到了一条会失败的测试上**。

**可核实信息（均 README、`SECURITY.md`、`DEPLOYMENT.md`、`ci.yml`、`citation_allowlist.py`、`test_citation_allowlist_sync.py`、`test_benchmark_deterministic.py` 与清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 每一封信在到达用户之前都过一个「无 LLM」的质控节点**——**README 逐字**：**「**Accuracy Core (deterministic appeal QA): Every drafted letter passes through a no-LLM QA node before it reaches the user**」**。**⭐ 即**「**模型写的东西在给人看之前先被一套确定性检查过一遍**」**——**这不是「我们用了 AI」，而是「我们在哪一步不信任 AI」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 引用核对有两条依据，且不可核实的内容会被标出来而不是默默放行**——**README 逐字**：**「**each statute the letter cites is checked against a sourced allowlist (`app/engine/citation_allowlist.py`) and the knowledge chunks the model was actually shown; each quoted policy clause is matched against the retrieved policy pages (with page-drift detection).**」**，**紧接着**：**「**Anything unverifiable is marked**」**，**随后给出一个方括号标记**（**方括号内先是** `VERIFY:`**，再接一个省略号字符**），**末尾逐字**：**「**in the letter, never silently trusted.**」**。**⭐ 三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 两条依据**——**「**允许清单**」**（**这份法规在不在名单里**）**与**「**模型实际看到的片段**」（**这句引文有没有出现在喂给它的原文里**）**——**⭐ 即**「**我允许你引用什么**」与「**我刚才到底给了你什么**」**是两个独立检查**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 引文要有**页面漂移检测**（`page-drift detection`）**——**⭐ 即**它知道**「**同一句话在扫描件与文本层里可能落到不同页**」**这类具体失败**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 不可核实的不是被删掉，而是被标出来**（**`never silently trusted`**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮四条里「不确定怎么处理」写得最好的一句**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 允许清单模块的文档字符串本身就是一份「我不知道」声明**——`backend/app/engine/citation_allowlist.py`（**实测 17,264 字节**）**开头逐字**：**「**Citation Allowlist — the set of statutes, regulations and guidance documents that PolicyCrab’s appeal letters are permitted to cite as VERIFIED.**」**，**并在 Why this exists 一节逐字**：**「**The LLM that drafts appeal letters is told "never fabricate citations", but an instruction is not a guarantee. This module is the deterministic ground truth the citation verifier (app/engine/citation_verifier.py) checks against.**」**；**字段说明逐字**：**「**source_url — the authoritative page for the provision (eCFR for CFR sections, uscode.house.gov for U.S.C. sections, dol.gov for DOL guidance).**」**与**「**verified_on — ISO date on which a human opened source_url and confirmed the provision exists and says what `display`/`aliases` claim. None means NOT YET HUMAN-VERIFIED.**」**；**并在 Sourcing discipline 一节逐字**：**「**The build environment this module was authored in could not reach ecfr.gov or uscode.house.gov, so every entry ships with verified_on=None. The verifier surfaces this as the flag ALLOWLIST_NEEDS_HUMAN_VERIFICATION until a maintainer runs `python scripts/build_citation_allowlist.py --checklist`, opens each URL, and fills in verified_on.**」**与**「**tests/test_citation_allowlist_sync.py enforces that every entry has either a verified_on date or needs_human_verification=True — silent, unsourced entries cannot be added.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一段文字**：**它区分了「我核对了」与「我没能核对」**，**并把后者写进字段语义**（**`None` 的含义被逐字定义为** NOT YET HUMAN-VERIFIED**）**，**还说明**为什么**（**构建环境连不上那两个官网**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 但本次实测到一处不一致：同一份文件里的默认值与上面那段声明相反**——**同为该文件的 `AllowedCitation` 数据类逐字为**：`verified_on: str | None = "2026-09-10"`（**注释逐字** `# ISO date; None = not yet human-verified`**）**、`needs_human_verification: bool = False`；**而本次对整份文件做正则统计的结果是**：`verified_on` **只出现在文档字符串（5 处）、该数据类字段定义（1 处）与两个函数体（2 处）里**，**没有一条 `_ENTRIES` 条目显式传它**；`needs_human_verification` **同理，条目里从不出现**。**⭐ 因此按本次所读代码推断**：38 条**全部**取默认值，**`allowlist_needs_human_verification()`**（**逐字为** `return any(e.needs_human_verification or e.verified_on is None for e in _ENTRIES)`）**会返回 False**，**`unverified_entries()` 会返回空表**；**而 `DEPLOYMENT.md` 逐字承诺**：**「**Until then every letter carries the flag `ALLOWLIST_NEEDS_HUMAN_VERIFICATION` (visible in the UI as "reference list pending review").**」**——**即**那个「待人工复核」状态**在当下不可达**。**⭐ 本词条不推测作者用意**，**只把三样东西并排放出来**：**文档字符串里的声明、数据类里的默认值、以及 38 条没有一条显式设置它的实测结果**。**⭐ 另外一处可核查的结构事实**：守卫测试的断言是「**若 `verified_on is None` 则必须 `needs_human_verification is True`；否则该字符串必须能被解析成 ISO 日期且**不晚于今天**」——**默认值是一个具体日期，所以这条守卫今天会通过**；**而它一旦运行在 2026-09-10 之前的机器时钟上就会失败**（**⭐ 即**这条守卫的通过与否**取决于墙上时钟**，**而不取决于有没有人真的打开过那些官网**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 守卫测试把允许清单接到三处，而不只是自己检查自己**——`backend/tests/test_citation_allowlist_sync.py`（**实测 4,888 字节**）**文件头逐字列出四条守则**，**其中最值得抄的是第三条**：**「**Every statute literal asserted by the deterministic engines / prompts normalizes into the allowlist — code cannot instruct the LLM to cite something we cannot verify.**」**。**本次实测的五条测试**：**① `test_allowlist_is_non_empty_and_keys_match_entries`**（**断言清单至少 20 条且键等于各条自己的 canonical**）；**② `test_every_entry_is_sourced_and_verification_state_is_explicit`**（**断言 `source_url` 以 `https://` 开头、`display` 非空、**`origin` 非空并逐字注释**「**origin must say where in the codebase this is asserted**」**，**再按上面那套日期规则检查核实状态**）；**③ `test_display_normalizes_to_canonical`** 与 **`test_every_alias_resolves_to_its_entry`**；**④ `test_code_asserted_statutes_are_in_allowlist`**——**它带一份 18 条逐字法规清单 `CODE_ASSERTED_STATUTES`**，**每条上方逐字注明由哪段代码断言**（如 `regulatory_router.get_appeal_framework_details`、`grievance.CARC_PRECEDENTS + prompt rules 13/14`、`triage NSA rule, models/claim`、`appeal_routes.LEVEL_CONFIGS`、`bill_auditor`、`carrier_intelligence`），**逐条断言它们都能归一化进允许清单**；**⑤ `test_regulatory_router_framework_details_all_verifiable`**——**它遍历 `AppealFramework` 枚举的每一个成员**，对 `governing_law` 与 `regulation` **两段实际运行时文本跑正则**，**要求每一处法规引用都落在允许清单里**（**⭐ 即**这不是静态清单的自我核对，**而是对着真实代码路径跑**）；**⑥ `test_knowledge_base_statutes_are_in_allowlist`**——**它扫描 `knowledge_base/` 下每一个 markdown 文件里的法规引用**，**要求全部落在允许清单里**，**并在目录不存在时 `pytest.skip` 且逐字给出理由**「**knowledge_base/ not present (not shipped in the production container)**」（**⭐ 即**它知道**CI 里有、生产容器里没有**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑥ 清单的每一条都带一张反向依赖图**——`AllowedCitation` 字段逐字为 `canonical`／`display`／`source_url`／`origin`／`aliases`／`kb_concept_ids`／`verified_on`／`needs_human_verification`／`note`，**其中 `origin` 的注释逐字为**「**where in the codebase this is asserted**」，**实测取值如** `regulatory_router;grievance.CARC_PRECEDENTS;deadline_calculator;carrier_intelligence`、`knowledge_base/02;state_profiles`、`grievance prompt rule 12 (MHPAEA)`、`appeal_routes.LEVEL_CONFIGS`。**⭐ 即**这张表的每一行**同时回答两个问题**：**允许引用什么**、**谁在引用它**——**这是本词条见过的最完整的一种「引用接线」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑦ 键是三套编号体系的归一化器**——**文档字符串逐字给出映射**：`29 CFR § 2560.503-1` → `29cfr2560.503-1`；`29 U.S.C. § 1132` → `29usc1132`；`ACA Section 2719` → `phsa2719`（**括注逐字** `ACA §§27xx are PHSA §§27xx`**）**；`DOL Technical Release 2010-01` → `doltr2010-01`；**并由** `citation_verifier.normalize_statute()` **产出**。**⭐ 即**同一部法规的多种写法**被压成一个键**——**这正是把 LLM 的自由文本接回确定性查找的那一层**。**⚠️ 而判例被明确排除**，**逐字为**：**「**Case law (e.g. Estate of Lokken v. **PolicyCrab** (repository `sharma-sugurthi/policycrab`) **is an AI appeals engine for US healthcare bills**, describing itself verbatim as an AI platform built with production practices designed to help medical advocates, HR benefits managers and individual Americans navigate the complexities of US healthcare insurance: it ingests SBC and EOB documents, adjudicates overbilling and regulatory violations deterministically, and has autonomous agents draft regulatory appeal letters. **Measured**: **primarily Python**, **licence Apache-2.0** with the first five lines of `LICENSE` read this round, **1 star**, **11,901 KB**, **created 2026-07-05**, **last pushed 2026-09-10**, **default branch `main`**; **the README measures 7,916 bytes**. **The repository was enumerated this round through a `codeload.github.com` tarball**, because the core API quota was exhausted, **and measures 478 paths, being 448 files and 30 directories**: `backend/` 394, `frontend/` 55, `supabase/` 11, `knowledge_base/` 8 and `.github/` 3, with the root files `README.md`, `LICENSE`, `DEPLOYMENT.md`, `SECURITY.md` and `.gitignore`. **Countable groups include 35 test modules under `backend/tests/`, 13 modules under `backend/app/agents/`, 11 under `backend/app/engine/`, 8 under `backend/app/security/`, 8 scripts, 9 numbered SQL migrations and 7 knowledge-base markdown files.** This entry belongs to this round theme, **wiring something up until another system can use it**; **this entry considers it the most rigorous of the round four, because it attaches a plain-language requirement, never fabricate citations, to a test that can fail**.

**Verified information, all measured from the README, `SECURITY.md`, `DEPLOYMENT.md`, `ci.yml`, the citation allowlist module, the citation sync test, the deterministic benchmark header and the file listing**: **first, top: every letter passes through a no-LLM quality node before a user sees it**, verbatim as the Accuracy Core description stating that every drafted letter passes through a no-LLM QA node before it reaches the user. **That is not a claim of using AI but a statement of where AI is not trusted.** **Second, top: citation checking has two independent bases and unverifiable content is marked rather than silently passed**, verbatim: each statute the letter cites is checked against a sourced allowlist under `app/engine/citation_allowlist.py` and the knowledge chunks the model was actually shown, and each quoted policy clause is matched against the retrieved policy pages with page-drift detection; then, verbatim, anything unverifiable is marked in the letter and never silently trusted, the marker being a bracketed `VERIFY:` followed by an ellipsis. **So what the system permits you to cite and what it actually showed you are two separate checks, quoted clauses get page-drift detection, and unverifiable material is annotated rather than deleted.** **Third, top: the allowlist module docstring is itself a declaration of what is not known** — verbatim, that the allowlist is the set of statutes, regulations and guidance documents the appeal letters are permitted to cite as verified; that the model is told never to fabricate citations but an instruction is not a guarantee, so the module is the deterministic ground truth the citation verifier checks against; that a missing verification date means not yet human-verified; that the build environment the module was authored in could not reach ecfr.gov or uscode.house.gov, so every entry ships unverified; and that a maintainer must run the checklist script, open each URL and fill the date in. **This entry considers that passage the most copyable text of the round, because it distinguishes what has been checked from what could not be checked, gives the latter a place in the field semantics, and states why.** **Fourth, top, and measured this round as an inconsistency against that same passage**: the `AllowedCitation` dataclass in that very file defaults the verification date to a concrete date, `2026-09-10`, and the human-verification flag to false, while a regex count over the whole file finds `verified_on` only in the docstring, that field declaration and two function bodies, with **no `_ENTRIES` entry passing either field explicitly**. **So on the code as read, all 38 entries take the defaults, `allowlist_needs_human_verification()` returns false and `unverified_entries()` returns an empty list, which makes the pending-review flag that `DEPLOYMENT.md` promises — carried by every letter until a maintainer fills the dates in, and shown in the UI as a reference list pending review — unreachable at present.** **This entry does not speculate about intent; it places three measured things side by side: the docstring statement, the dataclass default, and the fact that none of the 38 entries sets it.** **A further structural fact is checkable: the guard asserts that if the date is absent then the flag must be true, and otherwise that the date parses and is not in the future, so with a hard-coded default the guard passes today and would fail on any machine whose clock is earlier than that date, meaning its outcome depends on the wall clock rather than on anyone having opened the source pages.** **Fifth, top: the guard tests attach the allowlist in three places rather than only checking itself** — the sync test header lists four rules verbatim, the most copyable being that every statute literal asserted by the deterministic engines or prompts must normalize into the allowlist, because code cannot instruct the LLM to cite something we cannot verify. **The measured tests are**: that the allowlist is non-empty with keys matching their own canonical values; that every entry has an https source, a non-empty display string and a non-empty origin, with the verbatim comment that origin must say where in the codebase this is asserted, followed by the date rule; that every display normalizes to its canonical key and every alias resolves; that a list of 18 verbatim statutes, each annotated with the module that asserts it, all normalize into the allowlist; that every member of the `AppealFramework` enum has its runtime governing-law and regulation text scanned for statute references that must all be in the allowlist; and that every statute reference in every knowledge-base markdown file is in the allowlist, with the test skipping and stating verbatim that the directory is not shipped in the production container when it is absent. **So the allowlist is wired to a static list, to a live enum and to the retrieval corpus at once.** **Sixth, top: every entry carries a reverse dependency map** — the dataclass fields are canonical, display, source URL, origin, aliases, knowledge-base concept ids, verification date, the human-verification flag and a note, where the origin comment says verbatim that it records where in the codebase this is asserted, and measured values name modules such as the regulatory router, the grievance precedents, the deadline calculator, the carrier intelligence module, a knowledge-base chapter and the appeal route level configurations. **Each row therefore answers both what may be cited and who cites it.** **Seventh, top: the keys normalize three different numbering systems** — verbatim mappings from a CFR section to a compact key, from a U.S.C. section to another, from an ACA section to its PHSA equivalent, with the parenthetical note that ACA sections 27xx are PHSA sections 27xx, and from a DOL technical release to its own key. **And case law is deliberately excluded**, verbatim, because no primary-source URL could be confirmed from the build environment, so case names are flagged for human review instead: what could not be confirmed is kept out of the allowlist but is not allowed to pass silently either. **Eighth: beyond that node there are three more controls with countable or checkable statements**, all verbatim from the README: an extraction quality gate that detects the sentinel values substituted when facts are missing, returns a where-to-find-it checklist, tells the drafting prompt to use bracketed placeholders instead of guessing, and can refuse to draft at all on critical gaps; a transparent success score with outcome calibration that shows a factor-by-factor case-strength estimate alongside the model own guess and records what actually happened so the score can be calibrated against real overturn rates; and an LLM-free regression suite that runs the deterministic engines over 200 benchmark cases plus 12 hand-written quality-gate cases in CI with no model or database access. **Ninth: the header of that suite states what it does not assert** — measured verbatim, that it runs only the deterministic engines exactly as the pipeline wires them, listing the call chain from claim construction through cost calculation, appeal-framework routing, deadline calculation, deterministic triage and the quality gate to the success score; that with no database and no model calls it is safe for CI and finishes in seconds; and the most copyable sentence of all, that it guards the ground truth the 200 synthetic cases encode against regressions and **does not assert anything the LLM decides**, naming contradiction analysis and letter text. **What was tested and what was not are written at the top of the same file.** **Tenth: CI runs the whole suite against four mock credentials** — the only workflow in the repository has three jobs. The backend job installs Python 3.12 and both requirement files, runs flake8 twice, first with a fatal-only selection and then non-blockingly with a complexity cap and a line-length cap, and then runs the whole test directory with a mock Supabase URL and three mock keys for Supabase and Gemini in the environment. **No model and no database is therefore not a slogan but four fake values in CI.** **Eleventh: deployment uses federated identity instead of a long-lived key** — the deploy job needs the backend job, runs only on pushes to main, declares read access to contents and write access to the identity token, as the verbatim comment says, required for workload identity federation, authenticates through the Google auth action with a workload identity provider and service account named in the workflow, and deploys with the Cloud Run action to a named service in a named region from the backend directory. **⚠️ The same command carries a flag allowing unauthenticated access, recorded here as measured**: the service is deployed as publicly invocable, which belongs alongside the Cloudflare and rate-limiting section of the security document; **no security judgement is offered**. **Twelfth: the security statements are separated and layered** — the security document measures 2,975 bytes and states verbatim that the backend uses local regular expressions and Microsoft Presidio to scrub protected health information and personally identifiable information from user documents before any data is sent to external model providers, that calls to the primary model provider are configured as zero-retention, that row level security restricts users to their own rows and administrative endpoints require an admin role in the token, and that a middleware optionally blocks requests not originating from verified Cloudflare address blocks to prevent direct-to-origin bypass. **The enterprise AI security framework is five named pieces**: prompt-injection shields using compiled regular expressions on both input and retrieved context, a deterministic policy engine that requires agents to submit a proposed action and request permission rather than act directly, a gateway running the shields on input and the policy engine on output, a human approval queue that deterministic halts route high-risk actions such as generating or submitting legal appeals into, and persistent structured audit logging of every proposed action and resulting decision, optimised for ingestion by security information systems. **One formatting fact is recorded exactly as seen: the rate-limiting line in that markdown file is a ticked checkbox, and no meaning is inferred from that.** **Thirteenth: optional features are documented as off by default rather than left vague** — the team workspace flag defaults to false, verbatim, with the frontend hiding every team control and the backend ignoring the team header so single-user behaviour is unchanged; migration 009 is inert until the flag is true and therefore safe to apply at any time with existing rows untouched; and migration 008 must be applied before deploying a backend that includes the accuracy core, since its table holds no protected health information and is deliberately excluded from the purge. **Three different orderings, can apply at any time, must apply before deploying, and takes effect only once the flag is on, are written apart.** **Fourteenth: both deleting and not deleting carry a stated reason** — a scheduled database job automatically deletes raw sensitive EOB extractions after thirty days, while the appeal outcome table is deliberately excluded from that purge, verbatim, because the table holds no protected health information. **Fifteenth: the environment table states which defaults are the safe production values** — verbatim, that the accuracy-core variables are optional and the defaults shown are the safe production values, then listing the policy for unverifiable citations, where annotate inserts a visible bracketed verify marker with the original letter preserved while strip removes them and off only reports, a fuzzy-match threshold for quoted clauses, the quality gate mode, the team workspace flag and an invitation lifetime. **⚠️ Two further mismatches between documentation and repository were measured this round**: the allowlist docstring tells a maintainer to run the checklist script without saying from which directory, and that path returns 404 from the repository root, the real path being under `backend/scripts/`, which the deployment guide gets right by saying to run it from `backend/`; and the README repository-structure block lists an environment example file at the root, while the listing contains only the one under `backend/`, so the getting-started instruction to copy that root file cannot be followed as written. **Both results are recorded without speculation about cause.**
